name: Semrush
tagline: SEO, PPC, content, competitive research, and AI visibility toolkit

pricing.notes: Official pricing checked 2026-07-30; SEO Pro monthly price shown at $139/month when not annual, and $117.33/month annual-effective.

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.limits: 5 projects/sites; 500 tracked keywords; 50 daily AI prompts; 1 AI brand domain; 300 AI-visibility reports/day.

tiers.name: Pro+
tiers.limits: 15 projects/sites; 1,500 tracked keywords; 100 daily AI prompts.

tiers.name: Advanced
tiers.limits: 40 projects/sites; 5,000 tracked keywords; 200 daily AI prompts; API access.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.limits: Custom projects, keyword volume, AI prompts, users, data access, API capacity, and support.

pricing.freeTierCaps: 10 requests/day with 10 results/report; 1 Site Audit project up to 100 pages/month; 1 Base PDF report; no historical data
pricing.hiddenCosts: Extra users start at $45/month; Lead Generation is $90/month; Base Reports are $10 each and Pro Reports $20 each. Standalone AI Visibility starts at $99/domain/month on annual billing, with extra domains, prompts, and seats charged separately.

verdictSummary: You can build small audits and rank trackers, but Semrush's moat is massive keyword, competitor, backlink, PPC, and SERP datasets plus integrations and reports.
coreLoopDIY: Crawl a site, track selected keywords with an API, collect Google Search Console data, and generate reports.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay for market data and competitive intelligence that a solo builder cannot cheaply recreate.

priorArt.name: SEO Macroscope
priorArt.desc: Open-source technical SEO crawler; useful only for a narrow slice of Semrush.

rejectedAlternatives.name: OpenSEO
rejectedAlternatives.desc: Covers organic SEO basics, but no serious PPC corpus, advertising history or content suite; DataForSEO is compulsory besides.

rejectedAlternatives.name: SEO PowerSuite Free
rejectedAlternatives.desc: A respectable SEO toolbox that cannot save free projects and never had Semrush's PPC, content or AI-visibility breadth.

notes: Critical no because it prevents the site from overclaiming on data businesses.
prompt:
Build me a rank-and-health tracker for sites I own, covering the
self-collectable slice of Semrush. Requirements:

- A Node CLI on a nightly cron: better-sqlite3 for history, and a static HTML
  report regenerated each run.
- Track 20-50 chosen keywords through a SERP API (Serper or DataForSEO, key in
  .env); store position per keyword per day and draw movement sparklines in the
  report.
- Pull clicks, impressions, and average position per query from the Google
  Search Console API for my own properties (OAuth creds in .env).
- A technical crawl of my own site with crawlee: broken links, missing titles
  and descriptions, redirect chains, slow pages, as a table in the report.
- Email the report weekly via Resend (key in .env), but only when something
  moved: a position swing over 3 places or new 404s.
- No accounts, no telemetry; all history lives in one SQLite file.
- Out of scope: competitor keyword gaps, backlink databases, and traffic
  estimates for sites I do not own. Do not scrape or estimate third-party data.
- README: the cheapest SERP API tier for daily checks, the GSC OAuth steps, and
  a note that Semrush's moat is years of crawled keyword, backlink, and SERP
  data no solo build can collect; this tracks only what I own.
